## Loading the data

```{r}
library(car)
library(DescTools)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
```


```{r}
ptm_data <- read.csv(paste0(params$input_dir, "mydataLIMAptm_relabu.csv"), row.names = 1)
rownames(ptm_data) <- ptm_data$Replicate_Name

ptm_metadata <- ptm_data[,1:2]
ptm_data <- ptm_data[,3:ncol(ptm_data)]
ptm_metadata$group <- factor(ptm_metadata$group, levels = c("C", "H", "I", "E"), 
                              labels = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT", "HFE"))


# saveRDS(list("LIMA"= list("PTM_Data" = ptm_data, "PTM_Metadata" = ptm_metadata)),"./ptm_data_list.rds")
```

```{r}
comp_names <- apply(t(combn(levels(ptm_metadata$group), m = 2))[,2:1], 1, 
                    paste, collapse = "-")
comp_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(comp_names), ncol = 2)
rownames(comp_matrix) <- comp_names

tukey_results <- apply(ptm_data, 2, function(dt_var){
    anova_results <- kruskal.test(dt_var, g = ptm_metadata$group)
    anova_results <- data.frame("statistic" = anova_results$statistic,
                                "parameter" = anova_results$parameter,
                                "p.value" = anova_results$p.value)

    # anova_results2 <- aov(dt_var ~ 0 + group, data = lima_metadata)
    # comp_results <- list("Group_Test" = summary(anova_results)[[1]]["group",])
    comp_results <- list("Group_Test" = anova_results)
    #plot(anova_results)
    if(comp_results$Group_Test$p.value <= 0.05){
        comp_results$Pairwise_Tests <- DescTools::ConoverTest(dt_var, ptm_metadata$group)[[1]]
        # comp_results$Pairwise_Tests <- TukeyHSD(anova_results, which = c("group"))$group
        return(comp_results)
    } else{
        comp_results$Pairwise_Tests <- comp_matrix
        return(comp_results)
    }

})

anova_test_results <- lapply(tukey_results, function(ctrs){
    ctrs$Group_Test
})
anova_test_results <- do.call(rbind, anova_test_results)
# colnames(anova_test_results)[5] <- c("pvalue")
anova_test_results$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(anova_test_results$p.value)

contrasts_results <- lapply(comp_names, function(ctrs_row){
    ctrs_result_list <- lapply(tukey_results, function(ctrs){
        ctrs <- ctrs$Pairwise_Tests
        if(!(ctrs_row %in% rownames(ctrs))){return(rep(NA, 2))}
        ctrs[ctrs_row,]   
    })
    do.call(rbind, ctrs_result_list)
})
names(contrasts_results) <- comp_names

contrasts_results <- lapply(contrasts_results, function(ctrs){
    ctrs <- as.data.frame(ctrs)
    colnames(ctrs) <- c("difference", "pvalue")
    ctrs$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(ctrs[,"pvalue"], method = "fdr")
    ctrs
})

contrasts_results$Group_Test <-  anova_test_results

# saveRDS(comp_results_list, "./ptm_results.rds")
```

```{r}
rownames(ptm_data) <- make.names(rownames(ptm_data))

ptm_metadata <- data.frame("samplename" = make.names(ptm_metadata$Replicate_Name),
                           "group" = ptm_metadata$group)
ptm_results <- do.call(cbind, contrasts_results)

ptm_results$readable_name <- gsub("_|\\.", "-", gsub("\\.[^_]+$|\\.$", "", rownames(ptm_results)))

ptm_exp <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = as.data.frame(t(ptm_data)), 
                                 colData = ptm_metadata,
                                 rowData = ptm_results)
rownames(ptm_exp)

saveRDS(ptm_exp, paste0(params$output_dir, "Histone_Modifications_Proteomics_exp_lima.rds"))
```
